Our 8-day Ladakh bike expedition was nothing short of extraordinary. The itinerary was perfectly planned, taking us through some of the most breathtaking destinations, including Khardung La, Nubra Valley, Pangong Lake, Hanle, and the world's highest motorable road, Umling La. The accommodations, food, backup support, and overall organization made the journey smooth, memorable, and enjoyable.

What truly made this adventure exceptional, however, was our Road Marshal, Phunsukh.

From day one, his humble, polite, and caring nature put everyone at ease. Riding through Ladakh's challenging terrain demands experience and confidence, and Phunsukh demonstrated both every single day. His leadership, safety briefings, route management, and constant support ensured that every rider felt secure and well looked after.

The true testament to his dedication came during our overnight stay in Hanle. One of our fellow riders experienced panic due to low oxygen levels and high-altitude sickness. Despite it being late at night and him being in a deep sleep, Phunsukh responded immediately. Within moments, he was calmly assessing the situation, providing assistance, and taking all the necessary steps to ensure our friend's safety. His quick thinking, professionalism, and genuine concern transformed a frightening experience into one that was handled with confidence and care.

Phunsukh isn't just an excellent road marshal—he is a dependable leader who genuinely cares about every rider in the group. His dedication, patience, and calm attitude are the reasons our expedition was not only adventurous but also safe.

If you're planning a Ladakh biking expedition, I highly recommend choosing this tour and, if you're lucky enough to have Phunsukh as your Road Marshal, you're in the best hands possible. Thank you for making this journey an unforgettable experience!

Overall average experience.
Good parts - they have amazing sales people who are very polite. Very nice ride Marshall and back up van operator/mechanic.

Average parts - they charged 32k for 8 day trip which is very high per market standard but considering high amount I had high expectations which did not meet.
Stay at all locations were out of city or far from market. Food was average at all locations.

Bad parts - Not a single day ride started on given time. People were doing what they like result everyday we reached stay around 7-8pm.
People were driving dangerously to which marshal was not able to do anything as they are guests.

Bikes were used and beaten up. Dents, worn off tyres and so on. One bike was burning oil everyday to had to top it up. Itinerary is cramped up so many sightseeings were done in limited time.

Worst part - everyday at least one bike broke down. Does not seem bikes were maintained. Bikes were brought down from vendor in whatever condition and mechanic did good job of making them road ready without any care for rider or what problems we may face on road.

Overall average to bad experience. Will not recommend golden eagle to friends or family considering there are better options available.

Note - funny story when our group was in Hanle. Around evening some people got call from sales people to change the home stay as some new people wanted to stay in same home stay where our group was staying from day earlier already.
Ultimately people refused to change homestay as we were to leave for leh next morning. It just shows how mismanaged overall trip was.
